company.shortDescription: Zr3i is a platform enabling carbon projects with PDD, dMRV, compliance, and climate finance.
company.description: Zr3i is a climate-tech platform that enables the development, financing, and management of high-quality carbon projects. It digitizes the full carbon project lifecycle—from project design (PDD) and MRV (measurement, reporting, and verification) to compliance with international standards and integration with registries, verifiers, and offtakers—making carbon markets scalable, transparent, and accessible, especially in emerging markets.
